verdict.rationale: React is itself a library. It documents first-party packages to build against: react-dom/client APIs such as createRoot and hydrateRoot, server rendering via react-dom/server, React Native for mobile, the React Compiler package, and TypeScript support via @types/react and @types/react-dom. The official developer surface is therefore clear, even though it is a UI library rather than a service-API SDK. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building against these packages, an explicit SDK or package reference index, and evidence that the TypeScript typings are first-party rather than separately maintained.
